# The Clean Standard

> Owner-operated commercial cleaning company based in Tampa, Florida, serving Tampa Bay:
> offices, medical and dental practices, retail, fitness studios, coworking spaces, and
> property managers. Also short-term rental (Airbnb) turnovers and residential cleaning.

## What we do
- Commercial and office cleaning, recurring and after-hours: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/commercial
- Office cleaning: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/blog/office-cleaning-tampa
- Medical, dental, chiropractic, and med spa office cleaning: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/blog/medical-office-cleaning
- Property management: common areas, clubhouses, leasing offices, vacant unit turnovers: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/blog/property-management-cleaning
- Airbnb and short-term rental turnovers with photo documentation: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/airbnb-str
- Residential: recurring, deep, move-in/move-out, post-construction: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/residential

## How it works
- Free walkthrough for commercial accounts; response within 24 hours
- Flat per-visit pricing based on square footage, frequency, and scope
- Written checklist for every space; owner on every account
- Recurring commercial service is month-to-month (30 days' written notice to cancel)
- Re-clean guarantee: missed checklist items reported within 24 hours are fixed at no charge

## Where we work
Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Riverview, Westchase, Carrollwood, Largo,
Pinellas Park, Seminole, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Wesley Chapel, St. Pete Beach, Treasure
Island, Madeira Beach, and surrounding Tampa Bay communities: https://www.settingthecleanstandard.com/service-areas

Office: Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm. Cleaning available 7 days, including after-hours commercial service.
